# Naurra.ai

> Naurra.ai is an AI company. It designs and builds custom AI agents and automation systems for businesses: quoting systems and custom CRMs, sales and lead capture, customer support, scheduling, proposals, document intelligence, and operations automation, with fixed-price, engineer-led delivery. Naurra.ai also makes its own product, a voice and chat AI assistant that runs Gmail, Google Calendar, Drive, Docs, Sheets, Meet, Tasks, and Contacts.

Naurra.ai is operated by NAURRA AI LTD, a company incorporated in Cyprus (registration number HE 493756). It was founded in 2025 by Athanasios-Ioannis Panagiotakopoulos, CEO & AI Engineer. The company website is https://naurra.ai/ and the Google Workspace assistant product is at https://naurra.ai/product/.

## Company at a Glance

- **What Naurra.ai is**: An AI company that builds custom AI agents and AI systems for businesses, and the maker of the Naurra.ai assistant for Google Workspace
- **Legal entity**: NAURRA AI LTD, incorporated in Cyprus, company registration number HE 493756
- **Registered office**: 10 Kyriakou Matsi, LILIANA COURT, 4th Floor, 1082 Nicosia, Cyprus
- **Founded**: 2025
- **Founder**: Athanasios-Ioannis Panagiotakopoulos, CEO & AI Engineer, who has personally delivered every project in the portfolio
- **Track record**: 15+ projects across 9+ industries
- **Industries served**: HVAC and MEP, automotive, legal and finance, LegalTech and aviation, travel, fashion, e-commerce and wellness, CRM and sales, media and social growth, quantitative analytics
- **Engagement model**: Fixed-price projects, scoped individually after a free consultation, with a detailed proposal within 48 hours
- **Delivery**: Productized AI agents typically ship in 3 to 6 weeks; broader custom projects typically in 4 to 8 weeks, with working demos from week one
- **Support**: Ongoing support and optimization after deployment
- **Contact**: support@naurra.ai or https://naurra.ai/contact/ (reply within 24 hours)

## What Naurra.ai Builds

- **Custom AI agents**: Purpose-built agents for a specific business operation such as quoting, lead intake, invoice triage, or reporting
- **AI quoting systems and custom CRMs**: Read inbound leads, pull pricing from the business's source of truth, draft a branded quote in the business's voice, and log everything in a lightweight CRM
- **Sales and multi-channel communication**: One AI across WhatsApp, Telegram, Instagram, email, and web chat, with CRM memory and human handoff
- **Customer support automation**: Triage, classification, drafted replies, auto-resolution of simple cases, and escalation with full context
- **Document intelligence**: Reading, classifying, and extracting structured data from contracts, invoices, leases, and other business documents
- **Workflow and operations automation**: End-to-end automation across Google Workspace, Slack, WhatsApp, Salesforce, custom CRMs, and legacy systems
- **AI consulting and integration**: Deciding between custom and off-the-shelf AI, then integrating AI into the tools a business already uses

Technologies used include the latest GPT models, Claude, Gemini, voice AI, autonomous agents, the Model Context Protocol (MCP), RAG pipelines, and NLP/NLU.

## Custom AI Agent Solutions

Productized custom AI agents at fixed pricing. Each one is built around the customer's exact workflow, products, and tone, not a SaaS template. Full catalog: https://naurra.ai/solutions/

- [AI CRM + Quoting Agent](https://naurra.ai/solutions/ai-agent-custom-crm-quoting-system-small-business/) (€3.5K–€10K, 4–6 weeks): Captures inbound leads from email, WhatsApp, Instagram and forms; pulls pricing from your source of truth; drafts a branded quote in your voice; logs everything in a lightweight custom CRM; follows up automatically
- [AI Invoicing Agent](https://naurra.ai/solutions/ai-agent-automate-invoicing-payment-reminders-small-business/) (€2.5K–€7K, 3–5 weeks): Issues invoices from billable triggers, chases unpaid balances, reconciles payments, and reports outstanding balance daily
- [AI Lead Capture Agent](https://naurra.ai/solutions/ai-agent-capture-qualify-leads-instagram-whatsapp-email-small-business/) (€2.5K–€8.5K, 4–6 weeks): Listens across Instagram DMs, WhatsApp, email, and web forms; qualifies leads against your rules; replies in your tone; routes qualified prospects to sales with full cross-channel context
- [AI Customer Support Agent](https://naurra.ai/solutions/ai-agent-handle-customer-support-emails-small-business/) (€2K–€7K, 3–5 weeks): Triages every support email, looks up real data, drafts replies in your voice, auto-resolves the simple categories, and escalates the rest
- [AI Scheduling Agent](https://naurra.ai/solutions/ai-agent-schedule-confirm-client-appointments-small-business/) (€2K–€5.5K, 3–5 weeks): Books appointments over WhatsApp and email, sends confirmations and reminders, handles reschedules, and reduces no-shows
- [AI Proposal Agent](https://naurra.ai/solutions/ai-agent-generate-proposals-statements-of-work-small-business/) (€2.5K–€8.5K, 4–6 weeks): Reads inbound briefs, searches past won proposals, drafts scope and pricing in your voice, inserts your standard clauses, and outputs a branded PDF

- [AI Travel Concierge](https://naurra.ai/case-studies/ai-travel-concierge-whatsapp-telegram-itineraries/) (Travel): A WhatsApp and Telegram concierge that cut itinerary creation from 3 hours to 20–30 minutes, saved 180+ staff hours a month, and grew monthly revenue from €15k to €27k

- [Full-Stack E-Commerce Platform](https://naurra.ai/case-studies/full-stack-ecommerce-ai-operations-platform/) (E-Commerce): Automates support, email marketing, social publishing, receipts, and SEO workflows for a wellness brand, reaching 100% automated operations

## The Product: Naurra.ai Assistant for Google Workspace

Product page: https://naurra.ai/product/

The Naurra.ai assistant connects to Google Workspace and lets users manage 8 Google services through natural language. Users speak or type commands like "Send an email to John about tomorrow's meeting" or "Create a project brief doc and share it with the team" and Naurra.ai executes them.

Key differentiator: multi-service orchestration. One command can trigger actions across several Google services at once. For example, "Create a meeting agenda doc and email it to tomorrow's meeting attendees" checks Calendar, creates a Doc, and sends it via Gmail in one step.

### Core Features

- **Voice AI**: Real-time voice assistant with barge-in support (interrupt while the AI is speaking)
- **Chat AI**: Text-based interface for the same workspace commands
- **Multi-Service Orchestration**: Single commands that span Gmail, Calendar, Drive, Docs, Sheets, Meet, Tasks, and Contacts
- **35+ Pre-Built AI Workflows**: Ready-made automations for common productivity tasks
- **Native iOS App**: Available on the Apple App Store (app ID: id6759445443)
- **Web App**: Available at https://naurra.ai/product/

### Supported Google Workspace Services

1. **Gmail**: Read, send, search, reply, forward, archive emails
2. **Google Calendar**: Create, view, update, delete events; check availability
3. **Google Drive**: Find, organize, share, create files and folders
4. **Google Docs**: Create, edit, and share documents
5. **Google Sheets**: Create, update, and query spreadsheets
6. **Google Meet**: Schedule and manage video meetings
7. **Google Tasks**: Create and manage task lists
8. **Google Contacts**: Look up and manage contact information

### Example Commands

- "Check my emails from today"
- "Schedule a meeting with Sarah next Tuesday at 2pm"
- "Create a new document called Project Brief"
- "Find the Q4 sales report in Drive"
- "Send a follow-up email to today's meeting attendees"
- "What does my calendar look like this week?"
- "Check my calendar for today, summarize my unread emails, and tell me what I need to focus on"
- "Pull the deadlines from my project spreadsheet and create calendar events for each one"

### Pricing

- **Free Trial**: 3 days, full access, no credit card required
- **Monthly**: €79/month
- **Yearly**: €799/year (save 16%)

All plans include full voice and chat AI, all 8 Google Workspace integrations, 35+ AI tools, and unlimited usage within the active billing period. Details: https://naurra.ai/pricing/

### Technical Details

- Real-time voice processing with Deepgram Nova-3 (speech-to-text) and Cartesia Sonic-3 (text-to-speech)
- LLM-powered intent parsing and response generation
- Secure OAuth 2.0 Google authentication; Google credentials are never stored
- End-to-end encryption, GDPR compliant
- Sub-100ms orchestration latency
- 99.9% uptime

## Frequently Asked Questions

**What is Naurra.ai?**
Naurra.ai is an AI company that designs and builds custom AI agents and automation systems for businesses. It also makes the Naurra.ai assistant, a voice and chat AI for Google Workspace.

**Is Naurra.ai an AI agency or a software product?**
Primarily an AI company that builds custom AI systems for clients. The Google Workspace assistant is its own product, available at https://naurra.ai/product/.

**Who is behind Naurra.ai?**
NAURRA AI LTD, a company incorporated in Cyprus (HE 493756), founded in 2025 by Athanasios-Ioannis Panagiotakopoulos, CEO & AI Engineer.

**What types of businesses does Naurra.ai work with?**
Businesses of all sizes, from startups to established companies, across HVAC, legal, automotive, travel, fashion, e-commerce, wellness, legaltech, quantitative analytics, and more.

**How long does a custom AI project take?**
Most projects are delivered within 4 to 8 weeks depending on complexity, starting with a one-week discovery phase and weekly demos. Productized agents from the solutions catalog typically ship in 3 to 6 weeks.

**What does a custom AI agent cost?**
Every project is fixed-price and scoped individually. Productized agents in the solutions catalog range from €2K to €10K. A free consultation leads to a detailed proposal within 48 hours.

**Can Naurra.ai integrate AI with existing tools?**
Yes. Naurra.ai integrates AI into existing workflows, including Salesforce, Google Workspace, Slack, WhatsApp, custom CRMs, and legacy systems.

**What makes Naurra.ai different from other AI agencies?**
Clients work directly with the engineers who write the code, not account managers. The founder has personally delivered every project in the portfolio.

**What does the Naurra.ai assistant do?**
It controls Gmail, Calendar, Drive, Docs, Sheets, Meet, Tasks, and Contacts through voice or chat, and can run multi-step workflows across several Google services from one command.

**How is the Naurra.ai assistant different from Google Assistant or Siri?**
It is purpose-built for Google Workspace productivity and executes multi-step workflows across multiple Google services in a single command, which general-purpose assistants cannot do.

**Is data secure with the Naurra.ai assistant?**
Yes. It uses end-to-end encryption and secure OAuth for Google authentication, never stores Google credentials, and is GDPR compliant.

**Is there a mobile app?**
Yes. The Naurra.ai assistant is available as a native iOS app on the Apple App Store, plus a web app at https://naurra.ai/product/.
